findings.fix: Move `submatrix_mul_JFin_mul_transpose` and `mul_JFin_one_mul_transpose_eq_det_smul` from `Algebra/AlgebraicGroup/Symplectic/RankOne.lean` into this file, next to `JFin_one_eq`. Then prove membership as `rw [GLSymplecticFin.mem_iff']`, apply the identity to `gᵀ` (`transpose_transpose`, `det_transpose`), and finish with `g.prop`/`one_smul`.
findings.issue: `toGL_mem_GLSymplecticFin` proves `gᵀ J g = J` entry by entry, using a 15-lemma `simp only` chain (`Nat.reduceAdd`, `Fin.zero_eta`, `Fin.mk_one`, …) and a `first | linear_combination h | linear_combination -h | ring` fallback. Main already has the general rank-one identity `mul_JFin_one_mul_transpose_eq_det_smul` (`M J Mᵀ = det M • J`), which the docstring cites in words but the proof does not use.

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/PresentedGroup.lean:69 `def of ... := mk rels (FreeGroup.of x)`; :94 `one_of_mem ... : mk rels x = 1`; grep found no `mk rels (FreeGroup.of x) = of x` lemma.
findings.fix: Add a private `mk_of : PresentedGroup.mk sl2zRelators (FreeGroup.of i) = .of i := rfl` and rewrite with it (`rw [← mk_of, ← mk_of, ← map_pow]`, and `rw [..., mk_of, mk_of] at h`) in both lemmas instead of unfolding the definition.
findings.issue: `of_zero_sq` ends with `exact mul_inv_eq_one.1 h`, but `h` is about `PresentedGroup.mk _ (FreeGroup.of i)` while the goal is about `.of i`. It only closes because `PresentedGroup.of` unfolds definitionally, and nothing documents this. `of_zero_pow_four` (line 101) relies on the same unfolding via `rw [PresentedGroup.of]`. Mathlib has no named `mk_of` lemma, so the dependence is invisible.

summary: The membership `SL(2, R) ≤ Sp(2, R)` is re-proved entry by entry with a brittle `simp only` chain, although main already proves `M J Mᵀ = det M • J` for 2×2 matrices. The presented-group relation lemmas depend, without saying so, on `PresentedGroup.of i` unfolding to `mk (FreeGroup.of i)`.
